hypothesis_candidates.name: forced_selling_exhaustion_four_surface_observer
hypothesis_candidates.baseline: deep-drawdown executable candidates without the combined flow, near-put-OI and price-stabilization selector
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: frozen top-1 next-open H10 default-off observer requiring deep drawdown, stable-PIT large-order inflow, near-price put OI and stabilization
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: cash, SPY, QQQ and same-day executable alternative
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: forced sellers exhaust while owner-authorized inflow absorbs supply, near-price put positioning bounds residual downside and stabilization confirms price acceptance
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: survival below 5 percent, non-positive net replacement value in either chronological half, fewer than 5 selected/settled decisions per evaluation window, or more than 40 percent single-ticker positive-PnL concentration
hypothesis_candidates.disposition: retain frozen observer; no new alpha ID

hypothesis_candidates.name: timestamp_safe_estimate_revision_price_expectation_gap
hypothesis_candidates.baseline: mapped estimate revisions without muted-price-response conditioning
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: timestamp-safe positive revisions whose next-session price response remains muted
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: fundamental expectations improve before price fully incorporates the revision
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: cash-conflict cohort stays empty or settled replacement value is non-positive across horizons
hypothesis_candidates.disposition: parked; zero cash conflicts and zero settled horizon cohorts

hypothesis_candidates.name: pit_dynamic_relation_shock_propagation
hypothesis_candidates.baseline: static sector or unconditional peer relationships
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: outcome-blind time-varying relation edges with economic provenance and a fixed source-name shock treatment
hypothesis_candidates.economic_mechanism: economically linked information propagates asynchronously across a bounded related-name panel
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: PIT edge provenance cannot be established, executable touches remain sparse, or lagged related-name replacement value is non-positive
hypothesis_candidates.disposition: declined for this iteration; relation surface remains below readiness
